title: Controllers & Routing
description: Learn how controllers handle HTTP requests, how action methods return responses, and how routing maps URLs to the right endpoint.
longDescription: This module teaches you the core of ASP.NET Core MVC: controllers, action methods, and routing. You will start by understanding what controllers are and how they coordinate between models and views. You will then learn about action methods, their return types, and the different ways to pass data from controllers to views — including ViewBag, ViewData, TempData, and strongly-typed models. The module continues with convention-based routing, where you will learn to configure URL patterns in Program.cs, use optional parameters, static routes, and the catchall wildcard. You will finish with attribute routing, route parameters, and constraints, giving you full control over how URLs map to your application's endpoints.
whatYouLearn: Understand the role of controllers in the MVC pattern
Return views, JSON, and status codes from action methods
Transfer data between views and controllers using ViewBag, ViewData, TempData, and models
Use default values, optional parameters, static routes, and catchall segments
Apply attribute routing with [Route], [HttpGet], [HttpPost], and route constraints
Build RESTful APIs with precise, maintainable URL patterns
